name: LUNA
description: The LUNA Surgical System is a digital robotic platform developed by Asensus Surgical for minimally invasive laparoscopic procedures. Designed around an open surgeon console and articulating 5 mm TrueWrist instruments, the system was engineered to integrate with the Intelligent Surgical Unit (ISU) for real-time digital image analytics. Following the acquisition of Asensus Surgical by Karl Storz in 2024, standalone hardware development of the LUNA platform was discontinued to direct its underlying digital and augmented intelligence software into Karl Storz operating room solutions.
